summary: Regression test on Vinovent connector rename (was 'vinovendpro'/'Vinovend Pro'). Backend Literal enum accepts 'vinovent' and rejects 'vinovendpro'. Frontend Connectors page shows 'Vinovent' card, no remnant of old label. Full flow (login manager -> open modal -> save config) works end-to-end.

minor.issue: Invalid provider (e.g. 'vinovendpro') returns HTTP 500 instead of 422. Root cause: handler validates via `Connector(**data)` inside the function body instead of typing the request as `payload: Connector` in the signature. Pydantic ValidationError escapes as an unhandled exception. Validation still rejects the value — only the status code is wrong. Fix: change signature to `async def create_connector(payload: Connector, user=Depends(...))` (or wrap in try/except -> HTTPException 422).

action_items: (Optional) Convert POST /api/connectors handler to accept a typed pydantic body (`payload: Connector`) so bad provider returns 422 instead of 500. Not blocking — validation itself works.
critical_code_review_comments: Handler `create_connector` (server.py:1091) instantiates the Pydantic model inside the function; the pattern should rely on FastAPI's automatic body validation to produce 422 automatically.

success_rate.backend: 75% (3/4 assertions — enum rejection is functional, only HTTP status is wrong)

seed_data_creation: Created a 'TEST_key_123' Vinovent connector via API and 'TEST_uikey_999' via UI, both left in DB (backend UI insertion). Test cleanup removed the 'TEST_key_123' one; the UI one persisted for manual verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rename is complete and working. If main agent chooses to fix the 500->422 issue for /api/connectors, re-run /app/backend/tests/test_connector_vinovent.py — test_reject_vinovendpro currently fails only because of the status code (500 vs 422).
rca of the issue: User-reported typo 'vinovendpro'/'Vinovend Pro' was corrected to 'vinovent'/'Vinovent' in backend Literal enum (server.py:1072) and frontend PROVIDERS array (Connectors.jsx:8). Verified via API (create passes, list contains) and UI (label 'Vinovent' shown, no 'Vinovend Pro' anywhere). Unrelated observation: invalid provider triggers Pydantic ValidationError -> 500 because the model is instantiated inside the handler.
